defects.what: Identical rounded bars create a mechanical ladder rather than a convincing water reflection.
Large nearly unmodulated dark face overwhelms the small lighthouse.

ZENE.craft_notes: Cohesive travel-poster palette, layered cliffs and crisp shapes; the lighthouse competes with the sun and heavy foreground.
ZENE.revision_notes: Sky darkened with gradient, brighter leftward beam, right-hand lighthouse and three boats achieved. The entire landscape, sun, water marks and original boats are mirrored, although only lighthouse/rocks and beam were requested to move; the retained sun still reads as sunset.

defects.what: Soft amber halo along the sea boundary weakens the otherwise clean flat shape language.

ZUKB.craft_notes: Clear lighthouse focal point and restrained angular rocks; boat silhouettes and beam read immediately, though detailing is simple.
ZUKB.revision_notes: All named additions and lighting changes made with dimensions preserved. Original boats, distant coastline and water marks also mirrored rather than kept in place; tower shading retained. Stars remain in place.

pairwise_round1.why: ZUKB gives the lighthouse stronger prominence and a cleaner focal hierarchy, while ZENE's sun and heavy cliff compete with it.
